current_direction: Technology categories do not advance in lockstep.

current_direction: Item-specific prerequisites produce Integrated, Adapted, or Incompatible.
reference_influence: Traveller controls/electronics and physical design dependencies; conversion references.

current_direction: Bounded senior-officer abilities support repair and jury-rigging.
reference_influence: Leader systems show the value and risk of characterful exceptions.
checkpoint_23_decision: Allow a limited 1-2 TL bridge, strain reduction, or one emergency jury-rig; never bypass hard blockers.
next_action: Define rarity, action cost, and per-battle/campaign limits later.

current_direction: TL 9 must be meaningful; milestones should be staggered.
reference_influence: MOO2 qualitative unlocks; GURPS maturity/efficiency; Traveller compactness.
checkpoint_23_decision: Anchor TL 1/3/5/7/9; use TL 2/4/6/8 for maturity, efficiency, integration, or smaller capabilities.

current_direction: Named standard player items at every TL with stable machine IDs.
reference_influence: Principle-led naming cadence across space-opera references.
checkpoint_23_decision: Keep current names as intentional drafts; reduce repeated Metric usage and require names to match mechanics.
next_action: Revise display names without changing component_id.

current_direction: Persistent cruiser lineage; Hull TL improves capacity and compartmentation without class escalation.

current_direction: Hidden bounded exposure groups and individualized major systems.

checkpoint_23_decision: Do not adopt a player-managed system string; retain bounded hidden exposure.

current_direction: Player should see consequences rather than calculate engineering worksheets.
reference_influence: Traveller quick versus detailed design and Triplanetary compact presentation.
checkpoint_23_decision: Provide standard components, direct compatibility summaries, and optional deep data.
next_action: Prototype ship-designer warnings after data is stable.

current_direction: References inform design but never override the Concept.
